description: This Java source file defines the class DefaultPersistenceCleanupConfig, which implements the PersistenceCleanupConfig interface. It encapsulates configuration parameters related to persistence cleanup operations, such as enabling status, durations, parallelism, and retention counts, often loaded from external configuration files. The class provides factory methods for instantiation and overrides methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.
